title: Proportionate Rigor
summary: Selects the lightest PBHP edition adequate to the stakes instead of applying one ritual to every decision.
mechanism: HUMAN and MIN support bounded decisions; CORE adds full evidence and receipt discipline; ULTRA adds independent review and reversal authority; ULTIMATE invokes the complete Project Shadow stack.
failure_modes: Tier selection after the preferred answer
test_status: Tier definitions are specified; burden, false-positive, and outcome calibration remain open.
next_tests: Measure time and burden by tier
